name: UF-style-clean
note: clean — crisp modern pixel art, flat shading. ENDESGA-32 palette, 160x160, 1-px outlines ≤2. — unfake grid snap (true model grid, reduced to the canvas), despeckle 0. Twin of FACTORY/style-clean.  (sample: seed 1370)

form.subject: a (red-roofed windmill:1.3) on a grassy hill, winding dirt path, blue sky, (puffy clouds:0.9)
form.negative: (3d render, realistic, photograph:1.3), (blurry:1.2), smooth gradient, (antialiased:1.1), jpeg artifacts, (text, watermark, signature:1.3)

sample_command: pixelmon 'a (red-roofed windmill:1.3) on a grassy hill, winding dirt path, blue sky, (puffy clouds:0.9)' --server rtx --no-open --show-prompt --lora pixel-art-xl.safetensors --lora-strength 1 --negative '(3d render, realistic, photograph:1.3), (blurry:1.2), smooth gradient, (antialiased:1.1), jpeg artifacts, (text, watermark, signature:1.3)' --style clean --out 160x160 --palette ENDESGA-32 --despeckle 0 --snap-pixels --snap-method unfake --pixel-size 1x1 --thin-lines 2 --seed 1370
